steps.title: Project Architecture Definition
steps.description: Design the structure of the high-performance Car Racer Pro game featuring procedural Canvas drawing, system-synthesized sound effects, and smooth rendering.

steps.title: Metadata configuration
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json containing metadata package 'com.carracerpro.app' and app name 'Car Racer Pro'.

steps.title: Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle with Android target/compile SDK 34, min SDK 21, and Java 8 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Manifest declaration
steps.description: Declare custom application settings, high-performance Hardware Acceleration, portrait lock, and the vibrate permission in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Sound synthesis manager implementation
steps.description: Create SoundManager.java to programmatically play sound effects like engine hum, coin pick up, level progression, and crashes utilizing Android's ToneGenerator and single thread scheduling.

steps.title: Game GUI Layout Specification
steps.description: Implement activity_main.xml structure with modern dark-neon styles, high score panels, a interactive start menu, difficulty selections, and gameplay HUD elements.

steps.title: Dynamic Game Engine design
steps.description: Develop GameView.java featuring 60FPS Choreographer ticking, procedural asphalt roadways, rotating 3D-effect coins, fuel canisters, obstacle tracking, collision bounding, particle explosion engines, and screen shake mechanics.

steps.title: Main Activity orchestration
steps.description: Build MainActivity.java to link UI views, orchestrate start/pause/game-over states, handle saved high scores via SharedPreferences, and bridge physics loops with the layout interface.

steps.title: Vibration & Tactile Feedback Validation
steps.description: Confirm immediate vibration feedback on crash triggers using standard systems without breaking on newer Android devices.

steps.title: Graphic rendering and Parallax background check
steps.description: Verify programmatic styling, road marks sliding downwards, scenery speed transitions, and car lighting structures are rendered correctly in the core loop.

steps.title: Game difficulty adaptation tuning
steps.description: Ensure that selected difficulty configurations properly adapt maximum obstacle speeds, target point steps, and fuel depletion scales.

steps.title: Building Car Racer Pro
steps.description: Complete final packaging, asset references validation, and assemble the fully functional debug version of Car Racer Pro.
